title: Windowcount
description: The windowcount module displays the number of windows in the current Hyprland workspace.

format.label: What to show
format.doc: The format for how information should be displayed. On {} the current workspace window count is displayed.
format.description: The text shown in the bar. Words in curly braces, like {icon}, are replaced with live values: see the list of placeholders.

format-empty.label: What to show when empty
format-empty.doc: Override the format when the workspace contains no windows window
format-empty.description: Override the format when the workspace contains no windows window

format-windowed.label: What to show when windowed
format-windowed.doc: Override the format when the workspace contains no fullscreen windows
format-windowed.description: Override the format when the workspace contains no fullscreen windows

format-fullscreen.label: What to show when fullscreen
format-fullscreen.doc: Override the format when the workspace contains a fullscreen window
format-fullscreen.description: Override the format when the workspace contains a fullscreen window

separate-outputs.label: Separate outputs
separate-outputs.doc: Show the active workspace window count of the monitor the bar belongs to, instead of the focused workspace.
separate-outputs.description: Show the active workspace window count of the monitor the bar belongs to, instead of the focused workspace.
